articles.title: From 'Riverdale' to Eternia: How Camila Mendes Trained to Wield Teela's Sword
articles.summary: Camila Mendes underwent intense sword and rifle training to play Teela in the new 'Masters of the Universe' film. She says the weapons became 'an extension of her,' helping her embody the warrior captain. The movie balances sci-fi action with Teela's emotional depth, hitting theaters June 5.

articles.title: NASA's Crew-11 Astronauts to Share 167-Day Space Station Saga
articles.summary: NASA astronauts Zena Cardman and Mike Fincke, along with JAXA's Kimiya Yui, will discuss their 167-day ISS mission at a public event on June 1. The crew traveled 71 million miles and conducted crucial research, including celebrating 25 years of continuous human presence in orbit.

articles.title: Silicon Skyscrapers: 3D Chip Stacking Could Extend Moore's Law
articles.summary: University of Illinois researchers have demonstrated a method to stack multiple layers of silicon transistors with 98-100% yield, potentially revolutionizing chip density. This monolithic 3D integration could keep Moore's Law alive by building circuits upward instead of shrinking them further.
